api.floor-draft.declared-base.description: Explicit unverified declared base only, never the current active floor or authenticated publication. Same full scope required.

api.floor-draft.inventory.description: Declared per-profile counts only. Each profile ID is recomputed using original T12 stableFacts; full product/component/target match, unique profile IDs, exact safe total. Not authenticated population, completeness, path reachability or qualification. Whole canonical inventory <=1MiB.

api.floor-draft.save-request.description: Closed canonical original, max1MiB including retained actor/projection/record capacity. Server recomputes proposal. Basis head cannot be maximum safe revision. Declared base/inventory must have same exact scope. Raw JSON duplicates/noncanonical numbers/aliases rejected. Same actor/key forever binds original full canonical bytes, including basis; no changed-body retry.

api.floor-draft.assessment.description: Server recomputes every scope/profile hash/count/version/reference and retains all original MissingEvidence. reviewRequirement describes future high-risk activation policy; saving a draft consumes no review and grants no active floor.

api.floor-draft.record.description: Immutable revision rebuilt from exact original request, actual SQL save time/result and original T05 source MAC. Draft ID is deterministic for exact full scope. Record/proposal SHA is recomputed; data alone grants no authority. Whole canonical record <=1MiB.

api.floor-draft.outcome.description: Exact original canonical ACK including historical SQL committedAt/observedHead, permanently authenticated by original result source. Saved observedHead equals record. Stale record=null and observedHead differs from original expected head. Stale is HTTP200 durable original result, not an error permitting implicit new Save.

api.floor-draft.context-result.description: Actual current authorization planning basis and protected planning head. current is the full DraftRecord, not a ref wrapper; null matches null planning head. Pending locators only current real actor/exact scope processing originals; lookup recovers original request. This is not the active floor.

api.floor-draft.history-result.description: Strict contiguous ascending revisions after requested afterRevision. nextAfterRevision is page last revision even when more=false; empty page echoes requested afterRevision. All immutable content/native/MAC links are checked.

api.floor-draft.resume-request.description: Unchanged original request/full scope only. It never initially admits an absent original or substitutes a new basis. A determinately invalid original can be transported for exact no-admit recovery: outer envelope is closed/within1MiB, but inner valid-save schema failure may produce only the specialized400 after the same full native proof. Schema rejection is not itself a no-admit fact.

api.floor-draft.lookup-result.description: Absent is not terminal and grants no new save. Existing request/result belong to exact current actor/full scope/key/hash. Committed always includes original full request and ACK; processing has original full request and null result. Locator state equals outer state.

api.floor-draft.not-admitted-error.description: Only Save or exact-original Resume, after actual same-pool original lookup lock then T05 head FOR UPDATE, complete native/MAC census/current dual create permission, no ledger/native/admission/outbox for original actor/key, and known-success transaction. Predicate is actual fixed command decoder rejection OR valid expected authorization differs from current actual authorization ref; never generic error/absence/deny/config/unknown or head CAS stale. Old SERIALIZABLE snapshot racing admission must real40001/retry. Both full hashes bind canonical Save and canonical {actorId,request}. Client retains fact+original; only exact current actor/scope/key/two hashes permit explicit user correction with new key; never automatic retry or new admission permission.

api.deployment-rollout.scope.description: Concrete four-dimensional scope. All dimensions are required and non-null; no wildcard scope is accepted.

api.deployment-rollout.management-author.description: T05 read reference uses recordKind/recordId, unlike the kind/id operation references above.

api.deployment-rollout.deployment-record.description: Full immutable configuration revision. A declared release reference or inline plan is not source qualification. The deployment reference hashes this complete record; draftSha256 hashes draft only.

api.deployment-rollout.frozen-plan-recor.description: Actual reviewed frozen record, not the inline configuration plan. The server verifies policyRevision=revision-1 and the complete record hash; freezing a policy grants no running/active/release qualification.

api.deployment-rollout.create-request.description: Closed original public request for deployment.create.v1. No actor, clock, precomputed child identity, grant or execution permission is accepted from the wire. The original authenticated actor participates in the server-owned internal identity.

approval.description: Exact approved revision3 of the original body. The server verifies two independent reviewers, original author and fresh MFA; this reference itself grants no authority.

api.deployment-rollout.abort-request.description: Draft-only rollout.abort.v1. The server authenticates the original association/body and requires an approved exact body. Running/active/quality operations remain unavailable.

api.deployment-rollout.review-input.description: Exact original T05 ReviewRequest. Its scope must equal the outer scope, expectedChangeRevision must equal change.revision, and the current read set and independent reviewer are authenticated by the server.

api.deployment-rollout.lookup-create-req.description: Same actor, scope, commandKey and complete original create body; this is not a result-ID query or a new create request.

api.deployment-rollout.lookup-abort-requ.description: Original abort lookup has unresolved/committed responses only. No create refusal proof applies to this operation.

api.deployment-rollout.lookup-request.description: Outer scope must equal originalRequest.scope. The server derives the original registered request identity, never from a caller-supplied digest.

api.deployment-rollout.history-request.description: Descending original authenticated T05 audit sequence; beforeSequence is exclusive. It is not a new order, client timestamp or acceptance time.

api.deployment-rollout.context-result.description: Direct owner JSON, with no transport requestId/result wrapper. Native/MAC sources and current exact scope are verified before any body is returned. canCreate is an observation, never an admission capability.
x-server-invariants: reference and planReference hash the complete returned records and equal the request references.
occupancy.id is SHA256 of canonical full scope.
canCreate requires actual current scoped change.create+commands.release, enabled admission and no open association.

api.deployment-rollout.create-response.description: Original committed OperationACK plus fresh transport protocolVersion/requestId. No pending/unknown ACK is synthesized; only requestId is refreshed on an authorized original replay.

api.deployment-rollout.abort-response.description: Original committed OperationACK plus fresh transport protocolVersion/requestId. No pending/unknown ACK is synthesized; only requestId is refreshed on an authorized original replay.

change.description: Original preparation revision1, even after reviews advance the current Change.

api.deployment-rollout.preparation-respo.description: Direct owner preparation ACK, not an HTTP result/requestId wrapper.

api.deployment-rollout.review-response.description: Exact original T05 review ACK/prefix. Current later Change state is a separate read; it never replaces a retained original response.

api.deployment-rollout.abort-body.description: Complete exact operation body that the operator reviews. Both actor fields are the original author; intent.base/id and binding.objectId name the same draft child.

api.deployment-rollout.approval-response.description: Direct protected approval/context JSON. The current authority is not execution approval. Preparation-context is limited to the original preparer; review-context uses the actual reviewer preflight, without adding change.read.
x-server-invariants: Full body SHA equals change.sha256; scope and binding are exact original sources.
change.revision equals number of authenticated reviews+1; reviewer identities are distinct and differ from author.
A first rejection terminates review; approved requires two independent approvals.
Preparation-context and review-context do not create a Change or replace final command authorization.

api.deployment-rollout.lookup-unresolved.description: Absence, pending or another unresolved observation is not a never-admitted/not-committable proof. Keep the original wire and key.

api.deployment-rollout.lookup-create-com.description: Permanent original result/reference locator, including after retained response expiry. No original ACK is recreated and no execution or refreshed retention is granted.

api.deployment-rollout.lookup-abort-comm.description: Permanent original result/reference locator, including after retained response expiry. No original ACK is recreated and no execution or refreshed retention is granted.

api.deployment-rollout.parent-advanced-b.description: Both references name the same actual historical configuration identity. Current revision is strictly higher; complete old/current native lineage, body and MAC sources are authenticated.

api.deployment-rollout.authorization-adv.description: Both references name the same original actor. Current revision is strictly higher and the server authenticates the real historical/current provision chain. Historical grants do not replace current read permission.

api.deployment-rollout.create-proof.description: Create-only irreversible original-request observation. publicRequestSha256 hashes canonical original public create bytes. internalWireSha256 is the server-verified internal BindCompositionCreate wire hash, not the public hash or T06 request digest. No actor/permission/absence/ACK is granted.
x-server-invariants: Current authenticated actor/fullscope/key and canonical public original must match exactly.
basis.original equals originalRequest.deployment or originalRequest.authorization according to kind.
basis.current has identical kind/id and strictly greater revision.
Accepted originals, including retired responses, take precedence. Different original digests retain conflict.
Processing originals require real original identity, authenticated ciphertext, current epoch/kernel and full sources.
Returned only after key-first MVCC admission fence, current authorization, full bounded source census and original Store known-success COMMIT. Unknown COMMIT/errors return no proof.

api.deployment-rollout.create-not-commit.description: Only deployment.create.v1 may return this third locator variant. It is neither never-admitted nor terminated, does not mutate the original and does not synthesize an ACK. Explicit UI correction must freshly re-query and preserve full original/proof diagnostics before clearing only the exact local pending. Never apply this predicate to abort/preparation/review.

api.deployment-rollout.lookup-response.description: Direct owner JSON. Create and abort have distinct closed not_committable proof variants. The initial abort variant is absent-original plus authenticated irreversible child closure only; processing abort remains unresolved. Permanent accepted/retired original locators take precedence. No requestId/result wrapper is added.

api.deployment-rollout.approval-locator-.description: No row/pending observation gives no permission to discard or reuse an original key.

api.deployment-rollout.preparation-locat.description: Authenticated permanent ORIGINAL actor/key/digest/source reference. retained/retired observes original T05 response retention; no response lease refresh, source rewrite, approval or ACK recreation occurs.

api.deployment-rollout.review-located.description: Authenticated permanent ORIGINAL actor/key/digest/source reference. retained/retired observes original T05 response retention; no response lease refresh, source rewrite, approval or ACK recreation occurs.

api.deployment-rollout.history-response.description: Direct owner JSON. All items refer to authenticated original permanent sources; sequence strictly descends below the exclusive request cursor. A non-null nextBeforeSequence is the last returned sequence. currentDeployment is current context, not a rewrite of historical references.

api.deployment-rollout.error.description: Existing machineError envelope: exactly protocolVersion/requestId/code/retryable; no SQL, paths, provider errors or secrets. Original route does not add retryAfterMs. A generic error never releases pending or proves no admission.

api.deployment-rollout.rollout-closed-ba.description: The same actual child was irreversibly closed by another authenticated original abort. The original request names revision 1 and current names the same child at the actual aborted revision 2. closingResultId identifies that other committed closing result; it is never an ACK or result locator for this original request.
x-server-invariants: original equals the complete original public request rollout reference, including kind/id/revision/hash.
current has the same kind/id as original and authenticates the actual aborted revision 2.
The complete creation, association, closing original result, native operation/receipt/output and all charged protected sources are authenticated in the same original transaction.
No parent edit, principal revision, elapsed retention, absent key, lease, processing state or unauthenticated claimed closure establishes this basis.

api.deployment-rollout.abort-proof.description: Absent-original abort-only irreversible observation. Public hash covers the canonical complete original AbortComposedDraftRequest, including its approval and references; internal hash covers actual BindCompositionAbort Wire and is distinct from the public hash and T06 digest. This variant neither executes nor terminates the original and grants no ACK or current authority.
x-server-invariants: Current authenticated actor/fullscope/key and canonical public original must match exactly.
Only an absent original key may return this initial abort-proof variant. A processing original remains unresolved until a separately qualified complete original cipher/context path exists.
An accepted original, including a retired response, takes precedence over any closing basis. A same-key different original retains conflict.
The original child reference at revision 1 is permanently superseded by its authenticated aborted revision 2 and another committed closing result.

Key-first ledger synchronization, native MVCC admission fence, current read authorization, complete source/cipher census, independent 1MiB/4096-ref/32MiB/T06 limits and known-success original Store COMMIT are mandatory. Uncertain COMMIT/errors return no proof.

api.deployment-rollout.abort-not-committ.description: Only rollout.abort.v1 with an absent original and the authenticated rollout_closed basis may return this variant. The original remains unchanged. Any future explicit local correction must freshly re-query this exact operation, preserve complete original/proof diagnostics, and clear only matching local pending. Create, preparation and review predicates must not be substituted.
